purpose: Stable scoped identity for one independently revisable Temporal Constraint bound to a self-owned Activity or Event subject.

columns.name: constraint_ref
columns.value_contract: Application-issued UUIDv7. The constraint is a scoped LR-05 dependent, not a NativeRef root.

columns.name: subject_native_ref
columns.meaning: Activity or Event NativeRef constrained by this rule.
columns.value_contract: B04-A admits only a self-owned Activity or Event subject; database trigger dispatch rejects other NativeRef families.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint
primary_key.reason: Stable identity of the independently revisable constraint owner.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_subject_native_ref_native_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Anchor the heterogeneous Activity/Event subject in the bounded NativeRef address space.

unique_constraints.name: uq_temporal_constraint_ref_subject
unique_constraints.reason: Support exact owner+subject integrity for immutable mutation receipts without collapsing subject identity into constraint identity.

indexes.name: ix_temporal_constraint_subject_native_ref
indexes.reason: Subject-to-constraint lookup and bounded subject integrity path.

triggers.name: trg_temporal_constraint_native_ref
triggers.reason: Restrict B04-A Temporal Constraint subjects to the frozen Activity/Event NativeRef families.

triggers.name: ctrg_temporal_constraint_owner_complete
triggers.reason: Require the scoped owner, rule MaterialState and current binding to become complete atomically by commit.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Stable constraint identity owns immutable temporal_constraint.rule MaterialStates; revising the rule appends a new MaterialState instead of rewriting prior state.
state_history.current_binding: Current rule selection is held in scoped_current_material_state and is distinct from newest-row ordering.
state_history.chronology: temporal_constraint_current_history records accepted currentness episodes; constraint identity survives revision and retirement.
state_history.immutability_policy: No generic runtime DML. Canonical mutation is exposed only through the bounded B04-A mutation capability.

lifecycle.retention: Retain stable constraint identity and historical rule states after retirement.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: Retire closes the current rule episode and removes only the current binding; it does not delete constraint identity or history.

obligations: Temporal Constraint remains distinct from Schedule placement and NativeRef identity
subject eligibility is bounded to self-owned Activity or Event
owner creation is complete by commit
runtime has no generic table DML authority
